FILE: app/notes/pointer-lock.json
```json
{
  "lockedNoButton": false,
  "lockedButtonHeld": true,
  "rightDrag": false,
  "touchDrag": true
}
```

I wrote the inferred behavior to `notes/pointer-lock.json`. I was not fully certain because the `.d.ts` does not expose the event-handler internals, so this is based on the standard free-camera behavior of left-button `movementX/Y` look, no right-button rotate, and one-finger touch look.
